events.event: Bank Indonesia raised the BI Rate by 25 bps to 6.00% at its 17-18 November RDG, citing rupiah stability and pre-emptive control of 2026-2027 inflation.
events.key_numbers: BI Rate 5.75% to 6.00% (+25 bps) · Deposit Facility 5.25% · Lending Facility 6.75% · economists split before decision: 17 of 38 polled expected a hike · macroprudential policy kept loose to support credit
events.why_it_matters: Higher BI Rate tends to lift loan, KPR and credit-card costs while supporting the rupiah, which sits above Rp18,000 per dollar.
events.spreading_evidence: Breaking headlines on CNBC Indonesia, CNN Indonesia, Bisnis, Kompas, Viva

events.event: The IHSG closed down 1.07% at 5,247.88 on 18 November after opening near 5,323 and touching 5,374, with the BI rate hike cited as the main domestic factor.
events.key_numbers: Close 5,247.88 (-56.88 pts, -1.07%) · open 5,323.49 · intraday high 5,374.36, low 5,240.69 · volume 250.81 million lots · value Rp10.64 trillion · previous close 5,304.76 (17 Nov)
events.why_it_matters: The index reversed a morning gain after the rate hike, showing how fragile sentiment is after the MSCI shock.
events.spreading_evidence: Daily close covered by CNBC, Kontan, Viva, Kumparan, Detik

events.event: The rupiah closed stronger at Rp18,232 per US dollar on 18 November after the BI rate hike, while JISDOR was set at Rp18,252.
events.key_numbers: Spot close Rp18,232 vs Rp18,256 prior (+0.13%, 24 pts) · JISDOR Rp18,252 vs Rp18,264 on 17 Nov · analyst range for 19 Nov: support Rp18,150-18,200, resistance Rp18,250-18,325
events.why_it_matters: A 25 bps hike bought only a small rupiah gain, so the currency is still deep in the Rp18,000s.

events.event: Foreign investors stayed net sellers of Indonesian stocks, with Rp440 billion net sold on 17 November and a smaller session-I net sell on 18 November, while cumulative foreign net sell reached about Rp98 trillion by 6 November.
events.key_numbers: 17 Nov net sell Rp440 billion, BBCA sold Rp249 billion · 18 Nov session I: buy Rp1.92 trillion vs sell Rp2.26 trillion (net about Rp0.34 trillion), BBCA bought Rp203.2 billion · cumulative net sell Rp98.08 trillion through 6 Nov
events.why_it_matters: Foreign money leaving is what pushes the rupiah and IHSG down together; BBCA flipped from heavy selling to heavy buying in a day.

events.event: Menaker Yassierli said provincial minimum wages (UMP 2027) must be set by 21 November 2026 and regency/city minimum wages (UMK) by 25 November.
events.key_numbers: UMP deadline 21 Nov 2026 (Saturday) · UMK deadline 25 Nov 2026 · sectoral provincial wages about 26 Nov, sectoral regency/city about 30 Nov (calculated) · governors must set UMP, UMK optional · no official percentage rise announced
events.why_it_matters: Every worker on minimum wage learns their 2027 pay floor within days.
events.spreading_evidence: Covered by CNBC, CNN, Antara, Kontan, Liputan6
